title: Speed shop without regressions
prompt: This existing game has coin pickups (leaderstats.Coins) and a HUD (PlayerGui.HUD with CoinsLabel). Add a speed shop without breaking anything: create a RemoteFunction at ReplicatedStorage.BuySpeed. When a client invokes it: if that player has at least 10 Coins, deduct 10 Coins, set their character's Humanoid.WalkSpeed to 24 and return true; otherwise change nothing and return false. Add a TextButton named "BuySpeedButton" to the existing HUD that invokes BuySpeed when clicked. Coin pickups and the coins label must keep working. Verify it in a running game.
